title: Alligator vs Crocodile + Turtle vs Tortoise

lines.text: One tooth gives a crocodile away.
Crocodiles usually have narrower, V-shaped snouts.
With its mouth shut, a crocodile's fourth lower tooth still sticks out.
An alligator hides its lower teeth.
So how do you tell them apart?
A sea turtle can swim 22 miles an hour.
A giant tortoise? Under half a mile an hour.
At the zoo, I just look for that one tooth.
